w: Swamishri attended the Kishore assembly and blessed the Kishores.

In the evening, Swamishri travelled to the town of Valiaa to bless an assembly in honor of the first anniversary of a hospital for tribal and local residents. Swamishri performed puja of the Shivalinga in the mandir on the hospital complex. During the assembly the tribals performed a traditional folkdance. In his blessings Swamishri preached on refraining from addictions and imbibing virtues in life.
Eradicating Dehbhav During a special question answer dialogue in the Divya Sannidhi Camp with Swamishri, a number of questions were first asked to the karyakars and then to Swamishri.
Q : What does Swamishri like?
Karyakars : By cultivating the virtues Swamishri possesses. Harmony ( Samp ). Friendship ( Suhradbhav ). Unity ( Ekta ). By doing ghar sabha . Humility. To abstain from watching television ….

Swamishri : Everyone has given the answers to what I like - to do ghar sabha , not to be cynical about others, etc. This is all true but the heart of the matter is that one should dissolve one's dehbhav and offer devotion (to God). If the dehbhav remains then all problems remain. We see the faults of others because of dehbhav . If one's dehbhav is erased then automatically all problems and conflicts will be solved. If one dissolves one's dehbhav and attains brahmabhav - that I am atma - then one will not have problems and lose interest in spiritual discourses, kirtans and bhajans .

This dehbhav cannot be eradicated immediately because it has befriended the atma for a very long time. This friendship is a bond with one's own body, base nature, desires, senses and mind. So how can they be severed immediately? One's dehbhav can be erased by engaging the body in discourses, bhajan-kirtan , seva and bhakti . We should pray to God to protect us from 'I ness' and 'Mine ness' …
God is fearless, therefore He makes us fearless. God is happiness, therefore He makes us happy.

In the evening, Swamishri visited the Hari mandir in Jadeshwar where Shastriji Maharaj used to stay during his visit. Swamishri narrated in detail how, through Shastriji Maharaj's blessings, the black rashes on his body disappeared. (For details see photo story )
Pramukh Varni Din celebration
Swamishri blessed 750 doctors during a Medico-Spiritual Conference at the mandir hall.
The evening assembly was celebrated as Pramukh Vani Din at the Raritan Expo Center.
At 11.50 am Swamishri visited the BAPS hari mandir in Cherry Hill, N.J. After performing pujan and arti of the murtis Swamishri blessed the assembly of devotees.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj had got out of the car and was going towards the stage. Seeing Anilbhai Patel of Vadodara, Swamishri called him close and asked, "You had some illness. Has it got any better?"
"Yes, Swami!"

Anilbhai was overwhelmed by this shower of affection from Swamishri. Seven years earlier Anilbhai had had back pain. Even after so many years, Swamishri remembered this illness of his. Anilbhai is a devoted volunteer here, and for the last seven years he has also been observing alternate-day fasts with the resolve that an Akshardham be built here.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was going to his residence. Jaiminbhai Patel was driving the car. He was describing the features of this car he had newly bought. This car has a screen on which all the information appears about which road you are on. Further, there is a security system such that if there is an accident somewhere and you press a switch above the car's mirror, the police get the information of where you are anywhere in America within a few seconds and arrive to help within minutes. The car had many such facilities.
Having said this, Jaimin and Hitesh slowly broached the subject: "Bapa! This car is just right for you, isn't it?"
Swamishri understood what they meant. So he said naturally, "For us, whatever is old is fine."

Swamishri really wanted to avoid the subject, but would loving youths let it go like that? They said, "But Swamishri, you have built so many new mandirs, and you build every mandir in a new way. So this new car...?"
Swamishri said, "That is a matter of God. Matters of God should always feel new." Then he added, "In the mandirs thousands of people benefit, and in this, only we ourselves get comfort."
Hitesh said, "When Shastriji Maharaj placed the shawl on you, you said that you would keep the devotees happy. So today accept this much of our request, keep this car and make us happy."
Swamishri said, "I have already made you happy, haven't I... I sat in this car and met you here. That has made you happy, hasn't it!"

Their wish to give a well equipped car to their guru, Swamishri, who travels day and night from village to village, was irrepressible. Hitesh said, "On this auspicious day we ask for nothing else. In return for your accepting this seva of ours, we are ready to give whatever you ask."
Swamishri said, "Just do what we are telling you!"
Hitesh and Jaimin said, "Bapa! It is our wish."

Swamishri said, "Do not have such a wish at all. Even if we sit in a small car or an old car, we are happy. Yogiji Maharaj was happy even sitting in Keshavji Chudasama's car. So do not talk at all about buying new cars."
Before Swamishri's detachment, both youths bowed their heads.

BAPS Care International & BAPS Medical Inc organized a Medico Spiritual Conference on the morning of Sunday, May 23, 2004. Held in the divine presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, hundreds of physicians, dentists, and pharmacists were present to hear about the crucial role spirituality plays in medicine.

All the speakers, including Pujya Doctor Swami , spoke at length about the existence of a higher power beyond medicine. In his blessings to the conference, Swamishri discussed that even though the doctors treat bodily diseases, there are countless diseases of the mind and the soul that can only be cured by remembering God.
After being greeted by the heads of Indian medical associations and local hospitals, Swamishri concluded the conference by individually meeting all of the attendees.
At 5.25 pm Swamishri departed from Vidyanagar and reached Bhavnagar at 8.05 pm.

Under the auspices of the murti-pratistha ceremony of the BAPS mandir a yagna for world peace was arranged at the Lakshminarayan Mandir. Seated around 51 kunds 500 devotees participated in the yagna rituals. During the yagna Swamishri performed pujan of the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Radha-Krishna Dev and the Guru Parampara and performed arti. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the function, “It is a wonderful and divine day today. This hall has been a venue for spiritual discourses, kirtans, festivals and yagnas. Yogiji Maharaj had presided over many assemblies held here. So this is a sublime place. Today a yagna has commenced and the murtis will be consecrated. God is within us, in our hearts. This is a matter of faith, and after perceiving his glory one should daily go for his darshan, bhajan and discourses.” Nagar Yatra At 3.00 pm a grand procession (nagar yatra) commenced with the murtis installed in three wonderful floats. The floats were made by Bengali craftsmen brought from India a month earlier. For the procession and pratishtha functions devotees had come from Tanga, Morongoro, Dodoma, Itimgaambeya, Lidimtevara, Arusha, Moshi, Shinyanga, Tobora, Kigoma, Bukoba, Musoma, Mwanza, Makamba, Nanshiyo, Kapunga, Deita, Nachingvuaaa, Tunduru, Songeya, Masasi and other places throughout Tanzania. Furthermore devotees from India, UK, USA and Indonesia were also present.

The procession resounded with dhun, bhajans and folk-dance performances. The police banded the procession, followed by youths on motorbikes, devotees from abroad holding flags of their respective countries, traditionally dressed children and youths performing folk-dances, sadhus singing dhun, Hansa Rath with the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, senior sadhus with Harikrishna Maharaj in a car, Hasti Rath with the murtis of Guru Parampara and the Mayur Rath with the murtis of Radha-Krishna Dev. The entire procession stretched for 1 km and it concluded after two hours.
Prior to his morning puja Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of BAPS hari mandir in Ambavadi, a suburb of Ahmedabad.

The mother of Saurabhbhai Dalal, the state's Energy Minister, passed away today. Blessing Saurabhbhai Dalal, of the family of Nandubhai Mancharam, a devoted devotee of Shastriji Maharaj, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Your family had the blessings of Shastriji Maharaj. Your mother has completed her work and has taken her seat in Akshardham. So keep strength. My blessings to everyone."

Gnaneshwar Swami phoned from Sarangpur. Jivabhai, who had lived in Sarangpur and run the generator for years, had passed away. On the phone, Pramukh Swami Maharaj recalled his steady life and his services. In the time of Shastriji Maharaj, when Swamishri was the kothari of the Sarangpur mandir, he had taken Jivabhai into service here, and from then until today he had served with a sense of belonging. Swamishri paid tribute to this seva.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj had a phone call put through to Shambhubhai Shantibhai Patel (Anand). Swamishri said to him, "You came here for the installation, but we could not meet. I saw you. I kept thinking in my mind, 'We will meet.' But you may think, 'It will be a burden for him,' but do not think like that; come and meet me."

This morning Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the balcony to bless the Yogi Jayanti assembly. On this divine occasion, showering blessings based on the words of the Yogi Gita, Swamishri said:

"Yogi Bapa said, 'O Shastriji Maharaj! Give me such virtues that I may always remain under your trials and remain in your refuge.' Everyone bears trials when they need something, as dependants. But this is a trial borne with pride. When trials come, one becomes restless and goes astray; but this is a trial in which one goes more and more into his refuge. Here trial does not mean trials of circumstances or of the body, but this: 'to remain friendly with devotees, not to keep one's mind apart, not to see them as ordinary humans, always to see divinity.' This trial is great. If one feels even a little dislike for anyone, there is no peace or rest. There is burning within. Physically we stay together, but our minds are apart. This trial is one that cannot be seen and cannot be borne."
This evening Dr Bhattacharya came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj.

In 1997 he had performed Swamishri's bypass operation. Slipping into the memory of operating on Swamishri, he said, "But I tell you one thing, nobody had that feeling. I can't duplicate that feeling also."
Bhattacharyaji also speaks Gujarati well, and in his awe he expressed this experience in Gujarati too, saying, "The experience I had while operating on him, I cannot duplicate (a second time)."

In his emotion he went back to speaking English: "I haven't got it again, but that time it felt as if I was operating on somebody special. And my feeling now is, this man was destined, to be the chief of this organization. But I had that feeling at that stage when I operated him."
Carried away by feeling, he also began speaking in Hindi: "At that time I told Tejas that I was having a different kind of experience."
Brahmviharidas Swami said, "The whole world is trying to get closer to his heart and you are the only privileged person who actually touched his heart."
Bhattacharyaji said, "I had a glimpse of the divine feeling on that day."
Then he said, "I believe that there is a super natural power, which touches and goes."
The same experience that Dr Subramanyam had while operating on Pramukh Swami Maharaj, Dr Bhattacharya had too. Indeed, if the great sadhu is the same, how could the experience be different!
Swamishri said, "The night before the operation you came to meet me..."
Then he said, "Swami Bapa (Pramukh Swami Maharaj) had told Tejasbhai, 'Be present throughout the operation the whole day,' and you said, 'Best heart to approach, no cholesterol, no fat.'"
Hearing this and all the other details of the operation from Swamishri's lips, Bhattacharyaji said in great amazement, "You remember everything from 20 years ago?!"
Atmaswarupdas Swami said, "Not just this, he remembers everything. And it is only that he does not say it; otherwise he even remembers our previous births."
Swamishri also recalled that among the sadhus of the entire Swaminarayan Sampraday, the first bypass operation was his own, performed by Bhattacharyaji.

Bhattacharyaji is a person driven by intellect, logic and action. He works without being swayed by anyone's influence or embarrassment. But he was truly greatly impressed by Swamishri. So after returning to Mumbai, he emailed Brahmviharidas Swami: "Every word I said is true from my heart."
